text.zh-TW: 確認車子有沒有自給自足認證（self-contained），以及要去的區域對自由露營的規定
text.en: Confirm whether the van is certified self-contained, and the freedom-camping rules where you are going

label.zh-TW: 當地政府與保育部官網
label.en: Local council and conservation department websites

text.zh-TW: 確認旺季要訂的假日公園（有電、水、廁所、廚房）都訂好了
text.en: Confirm the holiday parks you need in peak season (power, water, toilets, kitchen) are booked

text.zh-TW: 確認要住的保育部（DOC）營地哪些需要預訂、怎麼付費
text.en: Confirm which conservation (DOC) campsites need booking and how to pay

text.zh-TW: 確認沿途傾倒站（dump station）位置，大約每 2–3 天倒一次
text.en: Confirm dump stations along the route (roughly every 2–3 days)

text.zh-TW: 確認押金（可能很高）會凍結哪張信用卡的額度
text.en: Confirm the bond (it can be large) and which card it will hold

text.zh-TW: 確認渡輪預訂時報的車長正確（露營車要報長度）
text.en: Confirm ferry bookings carry the right vehicle length

text.zh-TW: 確認保險是否涵蓋碎石路，以及哪些路段租車公司禁止進入
text.en: Confirm whether insurance covers gravel roads and which roads the rental company forbids

text.zh-TW: 確認每天抵達營地的時間在日落前 1 小時左右（接電、加水、煮飯要時間）
text.en: Confirm each day reaches camp about an hour before sunset (power, water and cooking take time)

text.zh-TW: 確認租車附的用品清單（鍋具、寢具、電源線、水管）
text.en: Confirm what the rental includes (cookware, bedding, power lead, hose)

text.zh-TW: 確認海關對食物與戶外用品的申報規定（登山鞋、帳篷要清乾淨）
text.en: Confirm the biosecurity rules for food and outdoor gear (clean boots and tents)

text.zh-TW: 確認已安裝營地 App（如 Campermate、Rankers）並下載離線資料
text.en: Confirm a campsite app (e.g. Campermate, Rankers) is installed with offline data

text.zh-TW: 營地電源線（確認租車有附）
text.en: Campsite power lead (check the rental has one)

text.zh-TW: 鍋具與餐具（確認租車附件）
